description:
Scope: planning only for lib/zaq/ingestion/fts_backend/parade_db.ex:32 (the final then(&{:ok, &1}) of bm25_search_group_by/4). No production changes. This is a success path after real Repo.all and FTSBackend.group_results, not a separate error branch. An empty result is {:ok, %{}}; database/parser exceptions are not converted to tagged errors.

Evidence/prerequisites: test/test_helper.exs excludes :paradedb by default; .github/workflows/elixir-ci.yml test-paradedb job provisions pg_search + runs `mix test test/zaq/ingestion/ --include paradedb`. Existing @tag :paradedb integration coverage already calls the function in test/zaq/ingestion/fts_backend_test.exs:616-711 and test/zaq/ingestion/paradedb_dotted_literal_test.exs:56-75; fts_backend_test.exs:577-615 separately checks constructed SQL without extension, and :548-573 tests shared sanitizer properties. Thus first verify whether this is an excluded-tag/coverage-run artifact, not an untested branch. Existing zaq-5qu concerns ingestion.ex/browser gaps, zaq-wqw ParadeDB extension CI; avoid duplicating either. Coordinate with coverage merge owner before adding tests merely to change the default native-only metric.

Functional specification/files: edit test/zaq/ingestion/fts_backend_test.exs inside existing `describe \"ParadeDB query construction\" (or strengthen its existing @tag :paradedb executable scenarios). No new production module, test-only seam, fake ParadeDB function, tag removal, or native-SQL imitation. Preserve test/test_helper.exs and .github/workflows/elixir-ci.yml unless coverage-owner explicitly asks to change reporting in a separate issue. Reuse Zaq.DataCase SQL sandbox, Document.create/1, Chunk.create/1, Chunk.create_table(1536), FTSBackend.reset_cache setup, and real Repo. Keep async: false here because the existing module resets shared :persistent_term backend cache and runs DDL; do not introduce global mode or shared DB state. Use unique source prefix via System.unique_integer; sandbox rolls back rows and index. No external Mox mock; pg_search is the real behavior-backed database prerequisite. Assert the index/backend is active before exercising the executable query, using existing setup helper/FTSBackend.impl if necessary.

Tests to add before any implementation (test-only task):
1. Extend existing @tag :paradedb successful search test at lines 631-711 or add ONE focused tagged scenario beside it: create two documents with unique source paths (wanted vs excluded), 2 matching chunks in wanted with known distinct section_path/chunk_index and one matching chunk in excluded or wrong language. Search with `ParadeDB.bm25_search_group_by([\"city hall\", \"absent identifier\"], 10, [wanted source], \"english\")`. Assert `{:ok, grouped}`, exactly the wanted document key, exact section-path keys and chunk_index per returned entry, numeric bm25_score for direct matches; assert no excluded ID. This executes line 32 with nonempty grouped output, real OR/AND, source and language filtering. Avoid asserting exact unstable BM25 float, incidental SQL order, or scores between runs. Use terms/content chosen to tokenize unambiguously, and keep matching chunks' language english. If coverage owner finds existing test already meets this, tighten existing broad assertions instead of duplicating fixtures.
2. In the same tagged test group, assert a no-match query for a unique absent token returns exactly `{:ok, %{}}`, not an error or phantom result; this pins the same line 32 on empty Repo.all. Existing tagged tests at lines 616-629 assert only broad empty map; strengthen rather than clone.
3. Keep existing tagged dotted-literal regression at test/zaq/ingestion/paradedb_dotted_literal_test.exs and existing SQL-only `bm25_query` checks. Do not add a new property for the finite success/empty shape: shared query normalization/idempotency/dotted-literal properties already exist at fts_backend_test.exs:548-573; multi-branch SQL behavior is covered with concrete DB examples. No concurrency/timing requirement; DB calls are synchronous, no sleeps/polling.

Branches validated: nonempty real DB search -> Repo.all -> group_results grouping by document_id then section_path -> {:ok, map}; filtered/absent terms -> empty Repo.all -> {:ok, %{}}. Line 32 is a single unconditional wrapping expression, not 32 uncovered lines. Source/language and query form are upstream paths, not alternatives at line 32. Parser/extension errors should remain errors; do not change production handling for coverage.

Validation handoff (NOT to execute in this planning session): on a provisioned ParadeDB test DB with `pg_search` and `chunks_bm25_idx`, run focused `mix test test/zaq/ingestion/fts_backend_test.exs --include paradedb` plus `mix test test/zaq/ingestion/paradedb_dotted_literal_test.exs --include paradedb`; compare line attribution using a fresh backend-inclusive coverage report only in the later coverage phase following docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md (do not reuse stale reports). A default native-Postgres `mix coveralls.json` excludes :paradedb and cannot credit this path; report backend-specific coverage as a documented environment exception rather than gaming the default metric. Implementation issue check later uses `mix q` and isolated tests; post-review coverage-upper and final mix precommit are owned by the workflow. Ingestion E2E: no new journey/new UX; this is tests-only of the existing backend. Reassess running existing E2E only if implementation alters ingestion behavior (none planned).

Action reuse assessment: not applicable — test-only execution of existing FTSBackend.ParadeDB.bm25_search_group_by/4 and FTSBackend.group_results/1; no executable operation is added, changed, or orchestrated. Existing operation consumes query text/limit/source filter/language, returns {:ok, grouped map} and reads indexed chunks under database backend semantics; no actor/permission bypass is added (late permission checks are outside this backend). Code callers keep existing FTSBackend dispatch; no agent-tool/workflow consumer or Action exposure planned. Verification above protects existing backend output without parallel implementation. Docs to update: none unless reporting an environment-specific coverage exception in Beadwork/PR; no behavior or architectural docs change.

Dependencies: single test-surface step, no Beadwork dependency needed; reference related extension CI tracking zaq-wqw, not a hard dependency unless real pg_search runner unavailable. No architectural change or feature E2E issue. Done when grouped/nonmatch tests pass against real ParadeDB and coverage ownership distinguishes excluded default tag from truly missing real-backend execution; do not close solely because a number rose.

comments.text: Implemented the approved test-only scenarios in test/zaq/ingestion/fts_backend_test.exs: assert ParadeDB backend active before execution; broaden real indexed search to two matching chunks in distinct section paths plus an English matching excluded-source document; assert exact wanted document/section grouping, chunk indices, numeric scores, and exclusion; change the empty-result probe to a unique absent token. No tests/format/coverage commands run per coordinator instruction. pg_isready reports /tmp:5432 no response, so local DB prerequisite unavailable. Existing unrelated modification in test/zaq_web/live/bo/ai/ingestion_progress_test.exs was left untouched.
